title: A door makes all the difference
dek: Three hours, seven pizzas and a actual data to learn from.
fault_caption: Sensor glitch: an open thermocouple pins the MAX6675 at the top of its range (1,874°F). Baked by the sun. Not a real temperature.

pizza_blurbs.1: The opener — snap peas, prosciutto, arugula. Named after the chef himself.
pizza_blurbs.12: The crowd favorite: pesto, parm, olives, onion, artichoke hearts, salami, arugula after the bake.
